name: Online Subtitles
author: Vestra Player
punchline: Search and download subtitles for the current video
description:
Search OpenSubtitles.com or Assrt for subtitles by file hash and title, load them right away and keep a copy beside the video. Needs your own API key, kept in the system's secret store.
Find it in the right-click menu under Subtitles ▸ Online Subtitles.
